title: phanera alata
intro: Phanera alata, commonly known as the "Golden Rain Tree", is a species of plant in the family Anacardiaceae, native to tropical regions. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include the treatment of fever, cough, and respiratory issues due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Phanera alata include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and bronchodilator, making it useful for treating conditions such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of Phanera alata include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
